ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, arcs are drawn with points A and C as the centers and with radii longer than $AC$, intersecting at points M and N; line $MN$ intersects $BC$ and $AC$ at points D and E, respectively. If $AE=6\,\text{cm}$ and the perimeter of $\triangle ABD$ is $26\,\text{cm}$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that: $MN$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AC$,\\
$\therefore$ $AD=CD$, $AC=2AE=12cm$,\\
$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle ABD$ is 26cm,\\
which means $AB+AD+BD=26cm$,\\
$\therefore$ $AB+CD+BD=AB+BC=26cm$,\\
$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is $AB+BC+AC=26+12=\boxed{38cm}$;
